subject: Legislative Reform and Transparency Platform
overview: Candidate Anna Callahan detailed her campaign platform and key differences with her opponent during an election forum. She emphasized the need for structural legislative reforms and transparency to advance progressive policies.

items.title: Candidate Differentiation and Legislative Reform Platform
items.summary: Anna Callahan outlined her key policy differences with her opponent, advocating for House Speaker term limits, public committee votes, public records access for the legislature, and reduced concentration of leadership power.
